landing.title: One shopping list, shared
landing.subtitle: A single list for the whole house. It updates on everyone's phone at once.

errors.unknown: Couldn't get the app ready. Try again in a moment.
errors.anonymousDisabled: Anonymous sign-ins are disabled in Supabase. Turn them on in Authentication > Sign In / Providers > User Signups.

create.title: Create a list
create.subtitle: We'll give you a code so you can share it with whoever you want.
create.submitHint: Creates the list and takes you to it

join.title: Join with a code
join.subtitle: Ask whoever created the list for the code.
join.submitHint: Adds you to the list and takes you to it

errors.invalidName: Give it a name of at least two letters.

errors.invalidPin: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits.

list.joinCodeHint: Pass it on to anyone you want sharing the list.
list.joinCodeExpired: Expired. Generate a new one to invite people.
list.joinCodeUnavailable: Couldn't load the code. Pull down to try again.

rotate.title: Generate a new code?
rotate.body: The current code stops working right away. Anyone already in the list stays in; anyone holding the old code who hasn't joined yet will have to ask you for the new one.

list.copyCodeHint: Copies the code to the clipboard

realtime.connecting: Connecting to see changes as they happen…

items.empty: Type the first thing you need to buy up top and hit "Add".
